title: 📡 Live Win Probability
notes: 📊 NEW: every matchup on This Week shows each team's live chance to win, with a bar that moves as the games go. It's the same number the ESPN app shows.
🔮 Under each score is the live projected total, and every player shows a faded projection under their points that updates during their game.
🏈 Open a matchup to see each player's game: score, clock, and kickoff time. Players whose team has the ball are highlighted yellow, and red when in the red zone.
⤢ Tap Full Screen in an open matchup for an ESPN-style view that keeps your phone awake, plus a chart of how the win % has swung while you watched.
⚡ Scores refresh every 15 seconds while NFL games are on, and flash green when they go up.
🏆 Standings now highlight the top 6 teams, matching the 6 playoff spots.
